title: Megalosaurus: Complete Overview
name: Megalosaurus: Complete Overview
description: Megalosaurus ("great lizard") was a carnivore dinosaur of the Middle Jurassic (166 million years ago), reaching about 9 m. The first dinosaur ever scientifically described (1824). This record is the front door to the Megalosaurus database: what it is, why it matters, and how the other records in this archive fit together.

# Megalosaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Megalosaurus mean?", "great lizard"),
    ("What did Megalosaurus eat?", "carnivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "great lizard"),
    ("What is period?", "Middle Jurassic"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "166"),
    ("What is length?", "9 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "carnivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "England"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
